pricing_text:
Text tokens (per 1M): **$5.00** input, **$1.25** cached, **$10.00** output.
Image tokens (per 1M): **$8.00** input, **$2.00** cached, **$30.00** output. Changing the **quality** parameter significantly affects cost; by default we use **high**. Adjust it to your preference. — The table below shows the output cost of one image at common sizes. It does not include text input tokens from your prompt. (low / medium / high / xhigh / max): 1024×768 $0.00402 / $0.00903 / $0.03612 / $0.06420 / $0.14445; 1024×1024 $0.00588 / $0.01317 / $0.05268 / $0.09366 / $0.21072; 1024×1536 $0.00474 / $0.01029 / $0.04116 / $0.07377 / $0.16464; 1920×1072 $0.00441 / $0.00951 / $0.03945 / $0.07014 / $0.15780; 2560×1440 $0.00615 / $0.01434 / $0.05529 / $0.09828 / $0.22110; 3840×2160 $0.01113 / $0.02595 / $0.10008 / $0.17790 / $0.40026. Your total cost per request is the table price plus: Prompt text, at $5.00 per 1M tokens. A short prompt adds about $0.0001, and a 500-word prompt adds about $0.003. Each extra image when `num_images` is above 1. Partial images when streaming, 100 output tokens ($0.003) each. With `quality: auto` the model picks the quality, so the cost can reach the max column.
notes: تسعير بالتوكنات: usd = سعر توكن صورة مخرجة ($30 لكل مليون). per_image_estimate_usd = جدول fal لصورة 1024×1024 بالجودة الافتراضية high ($0.05268) + برومبت قصير ≈ $0.0001 → ≈ $0.0528. image_size الافتراضي landscape_4_3 (1024×768) → $0.03612 بجودة high. لا تستخدم quality=auto أو xhigh/max (حتى $0.21 لصورة 1K). num_images حتى 10 يضاعف السعر.
